items: [Powerful 8-Core Processor] Intel Core i3-N305 (8 cores, 8 threads, 6 MB L3 cache, up to 3.8GHz) with integrated Intel UHD Graphics — suitable for everyday performance, multitasking, and efficiency.

[Massive Memory & Storage] Configured with up to 64GB DDR4 RAM and a blazing-fast 2TB PCIe NVMe SSD, ensuring rapid boot-ups, instant application launches, and secure storage for large projects and media libraries.

[Immersive 17.3" Touchscreen] Enjoy sharp visuals on a 17.3" anti-glare touchscreen with wide viewing angles, vibrant color accuracy, and flicker-free technology—perfect for productivity and entertainment.
[AI Copilot & Windows 11] Preloaded with Windows 11 and a dedicated Copilot key, offering AI-powered assistance to streamline tasks, optimize workflows, and enhance overall efficiency.

[Modern Features & Connectivity] Lift-hinge ergonomic design, HP Fast Charge, Realtek Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.4 wireless card Modern Standby, Full-size, soft gray keyboard with numeric keypad, enlarged clickpad, 720p HD webcam with privacy shutter, Trusted Platform Module (Firmware TPM) support, dual mics, stereo speakers
